## Installing R and RStudio

Please download the version of R appropriate for your device and OS system:
  
  - [Windows Distribution Page](https://cran.r-project.org/index.html)
  - [MacOS Distribution Page](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/)
  - [Linux Distribution Page](https://cran.r-project.org/index.html)
  

After installing R please install RStudio from the following link: 

  - [Posit Website](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop)

## Packages for this Course

We will be using R packages from both Comprehensive R Archive Network (Cran) the central repository for R packages and Bioconductor another repository that hosts thousands of packages specifically made for biomedical research.

### Cran Packages

Below is the code needed to install the CRAN packages needed for this course and import them into any script:

```{.r}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "ggplot2", "pheatmap"))
```

```{.r}
Library(tidyverse)
Library(ggplot2) 
Library(pheatmap)
```

### Bioconductor Packages

Bioconductor packages work a litte differently. First the bioconductor manager package **BiocManager** must be installed first and then using the methods of that package you can install other Bioconductor package like DESeq2: 

```{.r}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
    
BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
```

These packages can be imported into a script/workspace like typical CRAN packages after being installed through BiocManager:

```{.r}
Library(Deseq2)
```
